# 2026 END OF SEMESTER 1 AND SEMESTER 2 EXAMINATION TIMETABLE - FINAL

## Overview
This document outlines the final examination timetable for the end of Semester 1 and Semester 2 in the year 2026. It details the serial number (S/N), school, class ID, semester, date, arrival time, room, number of students (NOS), serving department, module code, module name, examiner, invigilator, and chief invigilator for each examination.

## Examination Schedule Summary
- Covers multiple schools including SoBE, SoE, SoST, and various Diploma programs.
- Dates span across November 2026 for both semesters.
- Lists specific venues such as COMESA, CCD-HALL, SPORTS COMPLEX, CAFE, WET labs, and various lecture theatres (e.g., CC-LT1, NT rooms).

*(Note: The complete detailed schedule comprises 1627 individual entries listing specific modules, times, venues, and personnel across all participating departments.)*
